subject: settings.spec export 'failed': fixed in 118f9eb
body: Cause: with NAADI_STORAGE_URL set (as the RUNBOOK stack does) but no NAADI_STORAGE_SERVICE_KEY, the API signs storage calls with the auth server's key, which the bare storage-api refuses, so every export job ends 'failed' (export_failed). Product behaviour is right; the e2e config now mints the stack's storage key itself when only the URL is given (apps/web/playwright.config.ts). Verified: the export test fails ('failed') without the change and passes with it on webkit-ipad-portrait, with NAADI_STORAGE_SERVICE_KEY unset. Integrated 118f9eb; gate 1682 pytest + lint/typecheck/vitest green. If seg22's run sets neither variable, the 503 'unavailable' path applies instead, which the spec does not cover.
